definitions.explanation: The first-born grandchild, regardless of gender. A formal term used in family contexts, inheritance discussions, and historical or literary texts.

examples.japanese: {長孫|ちょうそん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれて→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧、⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大喜|おおよろこ}び→大喜び：28880_ooyorokobi⟧だった。
examples.english: The grandparents were overjoyed when their first grandchild was born.

examples.japanese: {長孫|ちょうそん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
examples.english: As the eldest grandchild, I always attend family events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{長孫|ちょうそん}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{先祖|せんぞ}→先祖：04040_senzo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather often told me, his eldest grandchild, about our ancestors.

notes:
Composed of {長|ちょう} (eldest, senior) and {孫|そん} (grandchild). Part of a family vocabulary series that includes ⟦{長男|ちょうなん}→長男：14519_chounan⟧ (eldest son), ⟦{長女|ちょうじょ}→長女：14518_choujo⟧ (eldest daughter), and ⟦{長子|ちょうし}→長子：25076_choushi⟧ (firstborn child). In traditional Japanese families, the {長孫|ちょうそん} may hold a special position, particularly in matters of inheritance and family succession.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長孫|ちょうそん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧: the first grandchild is born
- {長孫|ちょうそん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{可愛|かわい}⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧: to dote on one's eldest grandchild
- {内孫|うちまご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長孫|ちょうそん}: the eldest grandchild from the family line

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧: grandchild — the everyday word for grandchild
- {初孫|はつまご}: first grandchild — emphasizes being the first, with a warmer nuance
- ⟦{長男|ちょうなん}→長男：14519_chounan⟧: eldest son — same {長|ちょう} prefix applied to the son generation
